name: John Deere Cylinder Works - Moline IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Building fronts River Drive directly with no controlled perimeter checkpoint visible in 2023-2025 Street View; drive-in dock doors face the road with no fence or barrier arm. 'Gate 24' in shipping records is an internal Deere dock/department number, not a guarded perimeter gate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Four distinct building masses on the riverfront campus, shares the corridor with adjacent Deere Planter Works (idx 7).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Open paved apron on the riverside (north) face holds scattered trailers and containers used for material storage and drop staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 16 from drive-in doors visible on the south (River Drive) face plus loading positions along the north apron; imagery resolution limits an exact count.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide open paved aprons on the riverside and broad internal driveways leave ample room for added truck lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the dense Quad Cities metro riverfront industrial fabric of Moline.
